brief_data.deck: Dana Incorporated, the $7.5 billion driveline and e-propulsion supplier, agreed on 11 June to combine with Eaton's Mobility Group in a Reverse Morris Trust - an $11 billion-sales vehicle-systems company closing in the first quarter of 2027, under a new chief executive who came up through commercial and marketing.

risks.label: THE COMPANY CLOSES IN 2027
risks.detail: The combined business does not exist until the Reverse Morris Trust closes, expected in the first quarter of 2027 and subject to Dana shareholder approval.
risks.counter: Contract now on a term starting at close, so the brand launch and Season 13 land together.

risks.label: A SUPPLIER, NOT A CONSUMER BRAND
risks.detail: Dana sells to vehicle makers, so a livery has no retail job to do and the board will ask what it buys.
risks.counter: Price it as customer marketing against a trade budget: the paddock is manufacturers, not shoppers.

extended.ask: A 25-minute call with Byron Foster before the autumn roster round to size an Official Driveline & e-Propulsion Partner entry at Mahindra Racing on a three-year term starting at the close of the Eaton transaction, and to agree who from Light Vehicle Systems joins the engineering conversation.

value.text: Dana TM4 builds electric motors, power inverters and control systems; Dana engineers thermal management, sealing and driveline hardware. A works team's powertrain group gets a supplier bench to test ideas against between seasons, and Dana gets an engineering reference it can show to every other manufacturer on the grid.
value.label: Operational workstream (Mode A)

value.text: Mahindra Racing gains a partner whose customers are vehicle makers and fleet operators, which widens the guest list at the European and Asian rounds beyond the team's Indian corporate base and gives the commercial team a category it can sell again.
value.label: Commercial lift for the team

value.text: Electrification engineering recruitment is the hardest hiring market Dana has; a Formula E programme is the recruitment story that works with graduate engineers. On the content side, road-car transfer from a works Formula E programme is a narrative both parties can film.
value.label: Talent and content

value.text: Official Driveline & e-Propulsion Partner designation, sidepod and halo placement, an engineering exchange with the powertrain group, hospitality at the European and Asian rounds, and driver access for Dana's customer and recruitment channels.
value.label: What the team gives back

why_now.text: Eaton and Dana announced a definitive agreement on 11 June 2026 to separate Eaton's Mobility Group and combine it with Dana in a Reverse Morris Trust. The combined company is valued at more than $10 billion, with Eaton's Mobility Group valued at approximately $5.1 billion and Eaton taking a cash distribution of approximately $1.1 billion.
why_now.label: Trigger

why_now.text: On a fully synergised pro forma 2026 basis the combination is expected to carry approximately $11 billion in sales and approximately $1.7 billion of adjusted EBITDA, with $250 million of run-rate synergies targeted within 24 months of closing. Eaton shareholders will own at least 50.1 per cent. That is a top-tier global powertrain systems supplier assembled in a single step.
why_now.label: The company that results

why_now.text: Byron Foster became chief executive on 1 July 2026. He joined Dana in 2021 to lead the company's global commercial, marketing and communications work before running Light Vehicle Systems, Dana's largest business unit. A sponsorship decision does not have to travel up through a marketing function to reach him; it is the function he built.
why_now.label: A commercial chief executive

why_now.text: Closing is expected in the first quarter of 2027, subject to Dana shareholder approval and regulatory clearances. Formula E's GEN4 era begins with the 2026-27 season, and teams settle their partner tables in the autumn before it. A term agreed now starts as the new company gets its name.
why_now.label: The window

why_team.text: Mahindra Racing's partner table carries Mahindra & Mahindra as title and Tech Mahindra alongside it. There is no driveline, e-propulsion, thermal or components partner, so Official Driveline & e-Propulsion Partner is a clean designation at a Formula E team price rather than a Formula 1 one.
why_team.label: The open lane

why_team.text: Formula E lists Mahindra among the manufacturers committed to GEN4. A works entry means the team's powertrain engineering sits inside the building, which is the only place a Tier-1 partnership has anything real to do.
why_team.label: A works team in the GEN4 era

why_team.text: Dana has eighteen facilities in India, including a Pune plant building Dana TM4 low- to high-voltage electric motors, inverters and vehicle control units. Pune is home to Mahindra & Mahindra. The relationship has a commercial address before it has a livery.
why_team.label: India is where the two overlap

why_team.text: The Formula E paddock is Jaguar, Nissan, Citroen, Lola Cars, Mahindra and Porsche. For a company that sells electrified propulsion to vehicle makers, that is a season-long trade show with its buyers already in the room.
why_team.label: The audience is the customer list

ruled_out.reason: Mouser Electronics, TTI Inc., Molex and KYOCERA AVX already fill the components and electronics lane, with TotalEnergies on energy.
Castrol holds the fluids and driveline-adjacent lane, and Jaguar's own powertrain programme sits above any Tier-1 partnership.
A manufacturer team with its own powertrain supply chain; TAG Heuer and Hugo Boss hold the visible partner slots.
Nissan supplies its GEN4 powertrain to a customer team as well as itself, so a rival Tier-1 on the car sits inside its own supply politics; Castrol and Nagase already on the roster.
Sand Technologies, Teijin and Genpact occupy the technology and materials lanes, and Envision Group's own energy business dominates the brand story.
TWG AI, Quest Global, Crowe UK and Reflo occupy the engineering-services and technology lanes; Nissan supplies the powertrain.

ruled_out.team: Lola Yamaha ABT Formula E Team
ruled_out.reason: Yamaha's powertrain and Shell's energy partnership crowd the technical lane, and Lola's constructor identity owns the engineering story.
Both have room, but neither carries a commercial adjacency to Dana's customer base of the kind Pune gives Mahindra.

brief_data.bottom_line: A vehicle-systems company with about $11 billion of sales is being assembled in public, and the executive who ran Dana's commercial and marketing function now runs the company. Mahindra Racing's partner table is nearly bare, Dana builds e-propulsion in Pune, and the GEN4 era begins as the deal closes.

score_cells.note: Agreement signed 11 Jun; the company itself lands Q1 2027.
score_cells.label: TIMING

score_cells.note: Tier-1 supplier; no consumer pull, but the paddock buys.
score_cells.label: BRAND FIT

score_cells.note: No hard deadline beyond the Season 13 roster window.
score_cells.label: URGENCY

score_cells.note: MODE A: e-motors, inverters, thermal and driveline bench.
score_cells.label: OPS FIT

brief_data.the_case_p1: Eaton and Dana signed a definitive agreement on 11 June 2026 to separate Eaton's Mobility Group and combine it with Dana in a Reverse Morris Trust, creating a company valued at more than $10 billion. The transaction values Mobility at about $5.1 billion and the combined business at roughly $11 billion of sales and $1.7 billion of adjusted EBITDA on a fully synergised pro forma 2026 basis, with $250 million of run-rate synergies inside 24 months. Eaton shareholders take at least 50.1 per cent. Closing is expected in the first quarter of 2027.
brief_data.the_case_p2: Dana closed 2025 with $7.5 billion of sales, $610 million of adjusted EBITDA and $85 million of net income after divesting Off-Highway, a supplier that has already chosen its ground in light and commercial vehicles. Byron Foster became chief executive on 1 July 2026. He joined Dana in 2021 to run global commercial, marketing and communications, so brand investment is his own discipline rather than a delegated one.

brief_data.value_content: MODE A - operational. Dana TM4 builds electric motors, power inverters and control systems; Dana engineers thermal management, sealing and driveline for light and commercial vehicles. That gives a works team's powertrain group a real supplier bench to work against, with Mahindra's road-car programme behind it. In return Dana gets a named technical partnership, livery presence, and a paddock of manufacturers that is its own customer base.
brief_data.why_team_para: Mahindra Racing carries only Mahindra & Mahindra and Tech Mahindra on its partner table, so the driveline, e-propulsion and thermal lane sits open at a works team committed to the GEN4 era. Dana's India footprint is real: eighteen facilities, and a Pune plant building Dana TM4 electric motors, inverters and vehicle control units in the city Mahindra & Mahindra calls home. The commercial conversation starts before the sponsorship one.
brief_data.deal_arch_para: Entry as Official Driveline & e-Propulsion Partner. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>THREE YEARS</font>, Seasons 13-15, so the term opens with the combined company's first year and the GEN4 era together. Estimated $1.5-3M a year, part-payable in engineering support. Scope: sidepod and halo placement, an engineering programme with the powertrain group, and hospitality at the European and Asian rounds.
brief_data.why_now_callout: <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9'>WHY NOW</font>  The combination closes in the first quarter of 2027 and the new company puts its name into the market then. Formula E's GEN4 era begins the same season, and teams settle their partner tables through the autumn.
brief_data.decision_maker_bio: Foster became CEO on 1 July 2026 after leading Dana's global commercial, marketing and communications from 2021 and running Light Vehicle Systems, its largest unit. Path: R. Bruce McDonald, Chairman, and Timothy Kraus, CFO since December 2021. No chief marketing officer is listed.
brief_data.opening_angle_intro: Lead with the new company, not the old one.
brief_data.opening_angle_quote: “Byron, you spent five years selling Dana before you ran it. In early 2027 you launch a company with $11 billion of sales that needs a name buyers know, and Formula E's paddock is your customer list. 25 minutes?”
